title: sandCustomSmithing
description: Custom smithing table, compatible with MMOItems
body:
早在1.20之后，我的世界锻造台都改了，需要模板才能合成

As early as 1.20, minecraft smithing table was changed and I needed templates to synthesize it

而一些牢牌插件，至今都没有更新。如MMOItems。

And some old plugins have not been updated yet. Like MMOItems.

![mmoitem的新增锻造台配方](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df8dbcddd3a0f62ecff88270de26b058edd5305b_0.webp)

Itemsadder也是只有两个合成栏位(懒得贴图了)

Itemadder also only has two composite fields (too lazy to texture)

用数据包又不能指定MMOItems的物品，而且无法指定数量

It is not possible to specify items for MMOItems using data packets, and the quantity cannot be specified

所有我开发了此插件，可以自定义锻造台合成配方，即使你没有MMOItems插件,原版的物品也是可以使用的

I have developed this plugin, which allows you to customize forging table synthesis formulas. Even if you do not have the MMOItems plugin, the original items can still be used

![展示插件合成](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85f3f04252dd564a8f3c09ad243b7ae770b71377.png)

我们也可以自定义合成物品的数量，是否转移组件，结果物品是否需要鉴定等等

We can also customize the quantity of synthesized items, whether to transfer components, whether the resulting items need to be identified, and so on

修改后输入命令/sandCustomSmithing reload，就可以重载配置了

After modification, enter the command/sandCustoms Smithing reload to reload the configuration
